scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:main && pnpm run test:renderer && pnpm run test:integration

scripts.core:test:packaged-cli-electron: node -e "if (!process.env.NODEX_PACKAGED_CLI) throw new Error('NODEX_PACKAGED_CLI is required')" && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/main/native-cli-electron.integration.ts

scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:cached: pnpm --silent run materialize:browser-runtime:mac && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch $(node -p "process.arch") --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/$(node -p "process.arch") --reuse-existing
scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:arm64: pnpm --silent run materialize:browser-runtime:mac:arm64 && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch arm64 --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/arm64
scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:x64: pnpm --silent run materialize:browser-runtime:mac:x64 && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch x64 --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/x64
scripts.stage:native-runtime:mac:arm64: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac:arm64 && MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch arm64 --out .generated/codex-runtime
scripts.stage:native-runtime:mac:x64: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac:x64 && MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch x64 --out .generated/codex-runtime

scripts.build: pnpm --silent run appshot-helper:build:dev && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts build
scripts.build:run:full: pnpm --silent run core:build:dev && pnpm --silent run build && pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac:cached && electron . --remote-debugging-port=9333
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:native-runtime:mac && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts verify && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:native-runtime:mac:arm64 && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts verify && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:native-runtime:mac:x64 && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts verify && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:codex-runtime:mac && electron-builder -mwl
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/landing/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint src/ packages/storybook/.storybook/ packages/landing/vite.config.ts packages/landing/src/ scripts/release/ scripts/ci/
